name: openclaw-plugin-harness-bridge
description: Register, configure, delegate and monitor coding-agent harnesses from OpenClaw.
author: 李冠华 (Liguanhua)

scripts.plugin:build: npm run build && openclaw plugins build --entry ./dist/index.js
scripts.plugin:validate: npm run build && openclaw plugins validate --entry ./dist/index.js
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm test && mkdir -p ~/.openclaw/extensions/harness-bridge && rsync -a --delete --exclude node_modules --exclude .git --exclude src --exclude tests --exclude docs --exclude reports --exclude '*.test.ts' --exclude vitest.config.ts --exclude tsconfig.json --exclude package-lock.json ./ ~/.openclaw/extensions/harness-bridge/ && echo '--- deployed to ~/.openclaw/extensions/harness-bridge ---' && echo 'SMOKE HINT: restart the gateway to load the new build (openclaw gateway restart), then verify: openclaw plugins inspect harness-bridge --runtime'
